{{dablink|For other uses of the word "dragon," see [[Dragon (disambiguation)|Dragon]].}}
'''''Commentary on the Dragon''''', by [[Sajius]], is a commentary on The [[Karaethon Cycle]]. {{ref/book|12|45}} Sajius claimed that the phrase "''He shall hold a blade of light in his hands, and the three shall be one."'' referred to the unification of three nations. [[Min]] believed that interpretation is incorrect, and that the passage has something to do with the use of ''[[Callandor]]''.

During the [[Last Battle]], [[Rand]], [[Moiraine]], and [[Nynaeve]] use ''Callandor'' to pull [[Moridin]] into their circle. Using ''[[saidin]]'', ''[[saidar]]'', and the [[True Power]], Rand creates a new seal on the [[Dark One]]'s Prison, thus achieving victory at Tarmon Gai'don.
